name: local-ai-studio
description: A local-first desktop studio: an agent per project folder running GGUF models, with safety enforced outside the model, plus local text-to-image generation. Offline by default.
author: justsimpleideas

scripts.package:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --publish never -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.test:engine: cd image-engine && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
scripts.addon: node scripts/native/addon.mjs build && node scripts/native/addon.mjs install
